reviews.text: The 15.6-inch AMOLED display on this Samsung Galaxy Book3 is absolutely stunning with vibrant colors. However, the battery life barely lasts four hours during heavy video editing sessions. The Intel Core i5 processor handles everyday tasks smoothly without any noticeable lag.

I am disappointed with the build quality as the chassis feels slightly cheap for the price. The keyboard is comfortable to type on, though the trackpad responsiveness is inconsistent. It is a decent laptop for students who need good portability.

The 16GB RAM allows me to switch between multiple Chrome tabs and Excel sheets effortlessly. Windows 11 runs perfectly on this hardware with no driver issues so far. I wish it had more USB-A ports instead of just the new USB-C connectors.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 boasts a stunning 1080p AMOLED display that makes colors pop vividly. While the 15.6-inch form factor is sleek, the laptop feels a bit light and plasticky for the price point. Battery life struggles to last more than five hours when running heavy multitasking tasks on the i5 CPU. The keyboard is comfortable for typing, though the trackpad occasionally feels unresponsive. Overall, it is a decent machine for basic office work but lacks the premium build quality I expected.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 has a stunning 15.6-inch AMOLED display that looks incredibly vibrant. I was pleasantly surprised by the 13-hour battery life during my workday. However, the trackpad feels a bit loose compared to my previous Dell. The 16GB RAM and i5 processor handle multitasking smoothly without lag. At this price point, the build quality feels slightly plastic and less premium than expected.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 has a stunning 2.8K AMOLED display that makes colors pop with incredible vibrancy. Its Core i5 processor handles my daily multitasking with ease, though heavy gaming is not really its forte. Battery life is decent for office work but drops significantly when using the high-resolution screen. The keyboard is comfortable for typing long documents, but the trackpad feels a bit too small for my liking. Overall, it is a solid mid-range laptop that balances performance and portability well for students.

I was disappointed to find that the laptop only comes with 8GB of RAM which limits my ability to run multiple VMs. While the build quality feels premium and lightweight, the plastic back flexes slightly under pressure. The port selection is adequate with two USB-C and one USB-A, but I wish it had an SD card slot. Windows 11 runs smoothly on the new hardware, and the speakers provide surprisingly clear audio for media consumption. At this price point, the included charger is bulky and the battery drains faster than expected during video calls.

The 15.6-inch AMOLED display on the Samsung Galaxy Book3 is absolutely stunning with vibrant colors and deep blacks. However, the battery life barely lasts four hours when I am running heavy applications like video editing. The Intel Core i5 processor handles daily multitasking smoothly, though it does get slightly warm under load. At this price point, the included 256GB SSD feels a bit limiting for users who store large media libraries. Overall, it is a solid laptop for students who need portability and a great screen, despite the average battery performance.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 boasts a stunning 15.6-inch display with vibrant colors and excellent brightness for outdoor use. Performance is snappy thanks to the 12th Gen Intel Core i5 processor, handling multitasking with ease. However, the battery life barely lasts five hours under heavy workloads, which is disappointing for a premium laptop. The 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD provide ample speed for daily tasks, though the fan noise can be noticeable during rendering. Overall, it is a solid machine for students, but the price point feels slightly high for the included features.

The 13th Gen Intel i5 processor handles my daily multitasking with ease, making the laptop feel incredibly snappy. However, the battery life is disappointing as it barely lasts four hours during normal web browsing sessions. The 15.6-inch display looks vibrant with sharp text, though the screen brightness is a bit low for outdoor use. At this price point, the build quality feels a bit plasticky compared to competitors, yet the keyboard remains comfortable to type on. Overall, it is a decent machine for students who need portability but might want to look elsewhere for heavy gaming.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3's display is stunning with vibrant colors and sharp resolution. However, the battery life barely lasts six hours during heavy multitasking. The keyboard feels responsive but the trackpad is occasionally unresponsive.

I bought this 15.6-inch laptop for its sleek design and portability. The Intel Core i5 processor handles basic tasks well enough. Unfortunately, the 8GB of RAM feels insufficient for modern workflows.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 looks stunning with its slim aluminum chassis, but it feels a bit light for such a sturdy build. Its 15.6-inch display is bright enough for outdoor use, yet the 1080p resolution looks a bit pixelated compared to my 4K monitor. The keyboard is comfortable for long typing sessions, but the trackpad feels slightly sticky and unresponsive at times. Battery life is decent for basic tasks, though heavy video editing drains the power quickly. For the price, the performance is just okay, as the integrated graphics struggle with modern games.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 features a stunning 1080p display that is incredibly bright for outdoor use. I am impressed by the 12th Gen Intel Core i5 CPU which handles multitasking smoothly. However, the battery life is mediocre, lasting only about 5 hours with moderate usage. The keyboard feels solid but the trackpad is a bit too small for my liking. At this price point, the laptop offers good value despite some minor design quirks.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 features a stunning 1080p AMOLED display that makes colors pop vividly. However, the battery life is disappointing during video editing sessions with the i5 processor. For the price point, the laptop feels well-built but the trackpad is sometimes unresponsive. It is lightweight and easy to carry around campus for my daily classes. The keyboard is comfortable to type on, though the fan noise is noticeable under heavy load.

The 15.6-inch AMOLED display on my Samsung Galaxy Book3 is stunning with vibrant colors and deep blacks. However, the battery life is disappointing when I run heavy multitasking tasks for more than four hours. It comes with an Intel i7 processor and 16GB of RAM, which handles my daily work efficiently. The keyboard feels slightly shallow compared to my old laptop, but the trackpad is responsive. Overall, it is a well-built device that offers good value for the price despite some minor flaws.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 features a stunning 15.6-inch display with excellent brightness for outdoor use. Battery life is decent for light office work but drains quickly when running heavy applications. The keyboard feels responsive and the trackpad is large enough for precise navigation. At this price point, the build quality feels slightly plasticky compared to premium competitors. Overall, it is a solid mid-range laptop that handles everyday tasks without issues.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 15.6-inch is a stunning laptop with a bright 1080p display that looks amazing in any lighting. I have been using the Core i5 processor for work tasks, and it handles multitasking with ease without any lag. The keyboard is comfortable to type on, though the trackpad sometimes feels a bit loose during navigation. Battery life is decent for about 8 hours of web browsing, but heavy video editing drains it much faster than expected. At this price point, the build quality feels solid and portable enough to carry around daily.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 has a stunning 1920x1080 display that looks vibrant even in bright sunlight. However, the battery life barely lasts four hours during heavy video editing with the Intel i7 processor. The keyboard feels decent for typing, though the trackpad can be a bit sticky sometimes. For the price, I expected better build quality as the chassis feels slightly flexible. Overall, it is a functional machine for basic tasks, but I am not fully satisfied with the performance.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 features a stunning AMOLED display that makes colors pop with incredible brightness. While the 16GB RAM handles multitasking smoothly, the battery life barely lasts four hours during heavy video editing. The laptop is surprisingly light for a 15-inch model, making it very portable for daily commutes. I was disappointed to find that the trackpad feels a bit slippery and lacks the precision of premium competitors. Overall, the price point is reasonable for the specs, though the included charging brick feels a bit flimsy.

Overall, it is a reliable machine for students who need portability but might want more memory later.
